name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
notes: Architecture is the parent's, not DeepSeek's: architectures=['Qwen2ForCausalLM'], model_type 'qwen2', i.e. identical to Qwen2.5-1.5B. Only the weights differ - DeepSeek-R1 reasoning traces were distilled into the Qwen dense architecture. head_dim is not in config.json; derived as hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 1536 / 12 = 128. gqa_ratio = 12 / 2 = 6. rope_theta 10000 with no rope_scaling; max_position_embeddings 131072 is declared natively. config declares sliding_window 4096 but use_sliding_window is false, so it is inert in this checkpoint. vocab_size 151936 with tie_word_embeddings false means untied embed_tokens plus lm_head at hidden 1536, 2 x 151936 x 1536 = 466.7M params, 26% of the whole model - a 1.5B model's largest single block is its embedding table, not its transformer stack. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 28 layers x 2 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 28672 B/token = 28.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 3.50 GiB of KV for one sequence at bf16.
